scope: Completed local source, controlled UI, built HTTP, real browser workflows with explicit runtime limits, native compilation/signing and isolated synthetic load. Deployment and physical-device acceptance are separate.

workflows: Fresh sign-in through real authentication UI and mock email, followed by session reload
Admin user activation through actual permissions form; newly activated account signs in
Representative bottom navigation, western customer scope, own activity visibility and server denial of management endpoints
Customer phone search and actual customer creation; SQLite confirms rep assignment and inherited western region
Visit customer selection, purpose and result, automatic controlled browser location and actual save; SQLite confirms precise coordinates and next action
Denied browser location blocks visit save; grant and retry succeed without reopening
Follow-up execution originates from previous visit; actual saved follow-up retains sourceId
Combined targets/performance page, actual manager target edit, invoice save and KPI review save; SQLite confirms invoice total and selected rep
Manager regional API payload excludes eastern rep; supervisor and manager targets are computed from their hierarchy
Actual Arabic and English installation-help fallback UI after authentication
All ten permitted administrator pages at360 px with no browser page errors or horizontal overflow
Customer, visit and follow-up fullscreen dialogs in Arabic and English at320/360/412 px
Post-input visit and follow-up inner scrolling keeps heading and save footer in360×800 viewport and outer dialog scrollTop0
Maps search selects correct factory; actual app tap requests canonical driving URL immediately in original user gesture, exposes same fallback href, and separately reports injected tracking failure

syntheticLoad.transport: local loopback TCP; paced synthetic users

behavior: Cold account hydration does not log out native tracking or clear its queue.
Foreground visit GPS is independent of background tracking activation.
Customer Directions opens through canonical navigation independently of recording synchronization.
Visit, service-intake and follow-up ambiguous retries reuse identical serialized requests.
New visits only link explicitly selected authorized stops; no implicit stale station timing.
Captured points and gaps retain original stop bindings and permission checks.
Same-owner scope/role recovery resets obsolete metadata only when no evidence is pending; old-scope evidence remains preserved and collection stops.
Role, region, own-entry and hierarchy permissions are maintained.
Route observation remains06:00 inclusive through18:00 exclusive Asia/Riyadh.
limitations: Physical Android installation, real GPS, Google Maps application handoff, lock-screen/background behavior and battery restrictions have not been verified on company phones.
Chromium content-shell popup crash was reproduced on a minimal page without CRM code; the actual UI test explicitly simulates a blocked popup and verifies the canonical fallback.
Content-shell service-worker promise failure prevented optional real PWA worker testing. Controlled worker privacy and installation UI checks passed.
Local synthetic load is not a Namecheap capacity or daily production reliability certification.
Unix-domain socket operations are blocked by the execution environment (EPERM); built HTTP used loopback TCP. Socket-aware entry configuration passed source tests.
A changed region or role with unacknowledged old-scope evidence stops collection and requires permission review before re-enrollment; normal visits and Maps remain independent.
